about: Defects the blind critic NAMED per judged sheet (rounds 01-04 of the joint lab), read from shots/scion2/evolve/joints/critic_verdicts.json by the library2 agent. tab = a tab/collar/lobe/tongue/plate shows; rim = white/pale halo or light rim at the seam (white notches/gaps are not rims); grommet = brad off its grommet, crescent or half grommet showing, or a bare brad with no grommet; colour = colour/material mismatch between the two parts.
